dedupe_keys.name: pathways transition scenario life cycle assessment

description: pathways is a Python package for life-cycle assessment of products, sectors and transition scenarios over time. Its own README says it reads a scenario with corresponding life-cycle matrices and calculates direct and supply-chain impacts. The JOSS paper stresses infrastructure build-up and decommissioning as well as operation. Spatial coverage and time horizon follow the scenario and life-cycle database supplied by the user, not a fixed collection inside the package. The own repository reports BSD-3-Clause. It can help compare environmental consequences of energy-system pathways that would be missed by operational emissions alone. A caveat is that impact results depend on the external database, scenario mapping and allocation assumptions. A computed impact is not a measured project outcome, and data rights are separate from the package licence. No directly related catalogue record was established; incidental catalogue uses of the word pathways were not identity matches. The article and own source were read without running an assessment.
name: pathways transition-scenario life-cycle assessment
notes: G5 G5-0742. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
